title: Formrobo
summary: A tool to automate your Google Form process.
description: When COVID-19 started spreading in Indonesia, schools switched to online learning. In my class we used Google Forms to mark attendance, so every weekday I had to fill in two or three forms a day. After a week this became repetitive, so I made this program to automate the process.

title: Dj Ecommerce
summary: E-commerce website built with the Django framework.
description: During the pandemic e-commerce became more popular, because people had to stay at home while still needing to buy things. I wanted to sharpen my Django skills, so I created a simple e-commerce website using an MDBootstrap template.

title: To Do App
summary: A to-do app to manage your tasks.
description: After learning the basics of Flask, I wanted to build a simple website with this framework to sharpen my skills. This is what I came up with.

title: Contact List App
summary: A contact list app using the Django framework.
description: After learning the basics of Django I wanted to deepen my knowledge and practice, so I built a contact list app.

title: YouTube Video Downloader
summary: A web app to download YouTube videos.
description: Sometimes I want to download a YouTube video. The Chrome extension I found limited the video resolution, so I built my own downloader using the pytube library with a web interface made in Flask.

title: Weather App
summary: A web app to forecast the weather.
description: After learning the basics of APIs I wanted to practice, so I looked for an open API and found a weather API. I read its docs and built the web interface using Flask.

title: Image Classification
summary: A machine learning project to classify images.
description: When I started learning machine learning I took an online course on Dicoding. This is a project from that course; the notebook is available on Google Colab.
